theme_overview: Calm + Intelligent + Premium + Trustworthy + Modern. Dark-first premium theme with deep navy/charcoal backgrounds, sophisticated blue/cyan gradient accents used sparingly, and semantic status colors.

components.cards: bg-[#13151D] border border-[#262A38] rounded-2xl shadow-xl shadow-black/40 overflow-hidden. Use inner padding p-6 or p-8.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-cyan-500 text-white rounded-full font-medium px-6 py-2.5 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_-5px_rgba(6,182,212,0.4)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1C1F2B] text-slate-200 border border-[#262A38] rounded-full font-medium px-6 py-2.5 hover:bg-[#262A38] hover:text-white transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-full px-4 py-2 transition-all

components.inputs: bg-[#0A0B10] border border-[#262A38] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-500
components.navbar: Fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#0A0B10]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5 transition-all duration-300
components.badges: Inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-[#262A38] bg-[#13151D] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium backdrop-blur-sm

motion.micro_interactions: Button hover lift (-translate-y-[1px]), subtle scaling (scale-95 on tap), and smooth border color fades. NEVER use dramatic swinging or spinning animations.

landing.hero: Cinematic. Left: Copy + CTAs. Right: Abstract AI signal network (built via Framer Motion nodes or react-tsparticles, NO stock photos). Glowing badge '✦ Explainable AI for Mental Health'.
landing.trust_section: 3 Bento-style compact cards (Multimodal, Intelligent, Explainable) fading in on scroll.
landing.product_preview: Component-built mock of Results card floating in center with subtle glow.

assessment_wizard.layout: Multi-step interface. Top connected step rail with active indicator. Content centered in a max-w-3xl container.
assessment_wizard.steps: 1. Facial (Webcam JPG/PNG upload), 2. Speech (MediaRecorder), 3. Self-report, 4. Behavioral, 5. Facial features, 6. Physiological, 7. Review.
assessment_wizard.transition_state: 2-4 second processing screen with staged checkmarks mapping to 'Behavioral patterns', 'Physiological indicators', etc.

results.header: Big central card showing class name and 'x% MODEL CONFIDENCE' with a radial chart or confidence gauge.
results.classification_distribution: 4 horizontal animated progress bars showing real probabilities. Colored by status.
results.future_severity: 3 compact data cards for Depression, Anxiety, Stress scores.
results.explainability: List of feature contributions sorted by impact, using +/-% metrics.

dashboard.layout: Greeting header. 3-column top stat cards. Main bento grid: Recent Assessments on left, Quick Actions on right.

profile.layout: Header with Avatar. Overview cards (Total, Streak). Timeline of recent activity. Placeholder empty states if no data.

accessibility_and_testing.testing: EVERY interactive element and critical data display MUST have a kebab-case 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'start-assessment-btn', 'result-confidence-score').
accessibility_and_testing.a11y: Use semantic HTML, maintain WCAG AA contrast for text (no gray-on-gray unreadable text), focus states via focus:ring, respect prefers-reduced-motion.

universal_guidelines: NEVER use generic full-screen gradients. Use solid deep navy with subtle radial glows for emphasis.
NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays; always use bg-color with backdrop-blur.
NEVER use default Vercel/Bootstrap look. Prioritize spacing (p-8 over p-4), 1px subtle borders, and smooth font rendering.
Do not invent backend data. All components must map to the defined real API payload fields.
Keep files as .js (not .tsx) as per the project constraints. Refactor App.js into modular components.
Use framer-motion for UI interactions (dropdowns, modals, transitions) to avoid abrupt appearances.
file_structure_plan: src/App.js - Router and global layout shell
src/pages/Home.js, Dashboard.js, Profile.js, Assessment.js, Results.js, Explainability.js, History.js, Insights.js
src/components/ui/ - Shadcn customized components (button.js, card.js, etc.)
